feeds.title: Blog | Thriving While Multiple | life after diagnosis, life beyond recovery
feeds.description: The author shares their decade-long struggle within a misdiagnosed mental health system, leading to over-medication and inadequate support. Eventually diagnosed with Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), they found clarity and took charge of their recovery through intensive therapy. The narrative aims to offer insight into their world, dispel misconceptions, and share their journey towards a fulfilling life. The story reflects a quest for understanding, healing, and empowerment.

feeds.title: Kate Is Rising
feeds.description: I have been diagnosed with Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder, Depression, and Anxiety. I am proud that I have survived. I have a lot to be proud of. If you are a survivor of abuse, you have a lot to be proud of as well.

feeds.title: Ears to Hear and Eyes to See
feeds.description: Shapeshifters is about my very particular perspective on Dissociation Identity Disorder, also known as Multiple Personality Disorder. I am just so damn tired of people who are afraid to know anything about these conditions assuming what it is and then acting on those false beliefs. D. I. D is not Schizophrenia; it is a condition in which one consciousness is divided to survive horrific trauma.

feeds.title: Life as a Committee
feeds.description: A 30-something year old woman living in Melbourne, Australia writes about living with Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID), (previously known as Multiple Personality Disorder) and Complex Post Traumatic Stress Disorder. Other issues along the way include mood disorders, anxiety, eating disorders, self-harm and suicidality.
